summary: A flat-topped crusader great helm (13th-century barrel helm): a riveted steel barrel with a flat crown plate… options channel0, channel1; sockets grip_r, grip_l, holster_r, sling_back.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.garment_head_helm_crusader or place "prefab": "garment_head_helm_crusader" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
